changes.before: Here is how we produce the monthly investment report today. Please draft the intent and the swim lane.
changes.after: Produce the monthly investment report in USD and SGD, today assembled by hand by Operations and Finance, in a way that can be mapped and automated.
The report is needed by the 3rd business day of each month. Four of the six steps are manual and re-typed between tools, and there is no single place that shows where a month stands.
Daniel Foo, Chief Investment Officer, Sofia Reyes, Risk
Daniel Foo approves the issued report, Sofia Reyes receives the pack and owns the limits
3rd business day of each month

changes.after: name: Collect the exports; who: Operations analyst; does: Downloads the administrator and trading system positions exports, saves them to the shared file drop, and compares row count and control total with the footer. A file that does not match is rejected and re-requested the same day.; inputs: Adm

name: Check cash against the administrator; who: Operations analyst; does: Pastes administrator and trading cash balances side by side per entity per day, reads the difference, highlights anything over 5,000 USD by hand, opens a break case and emails Raj Patel.; inputs: Checked raw exports; outputs:

name: Collect manager statements; who: Operations analyst; does: Saves each statement PDF, types fund, period end, value and received date into the statements tracker, checks it against the expected list, and writes follow-up emails for late or missing statements. Quarterly funds are carried forward

name: Convert to SGD; who: Raj Patel; does: Takes holdings values from the tracker and cash from the reconciliation workbook, and converts them to SGD by typing in the conversion with the WMR 4pm fixing for the period end. If there is no fixing, the report is held.; inputs: Statements tracker, Cash

name: Review and approve the report; who: Raj Patel; does: Assembles the report pack from the converted figures and sends it for review. Daniel Foo approves; a revision over the materiality limit reopens the review.; inputs: SGD conversion file; outputs: Report pack for approval; system: Report pack

name: Read the report; who: Daniel Foo; does: Reads the issued pack, which shows the version and cutoff time. Questions for managers are logged as open questions for the next cycle.; inputs: Issued report pack; outputs: Open questions for managers; system: Report pack
